verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no universal search bar spanning transactions, vendors and cards, and no search-to-payment shortcut. The closest items are separate API capabilities: card transaction retrieval and looking up Wise profiles by Wisetag, email or phone to add as recipients. These are adjacent building blocks, not the unified search experience the story asks for.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can search across all transactions, vendors, and cards from one universal search bar and jump straight into initiating a payment
